features.name: Long Meadow and Picnic House
features.description: Long Meadow is the park's broad north-side lawn; the Picnic House and nearby restrooms make this a practical gathering zone, but event setup and wet turf can affect access.
features.source_label: Prospect Park Alliance and NYC Parks

features.name: Prospect Park Lake and Boathouse
features.description: The lake and historic Boathouse sit in the park's southeast half. Use Ocean Avenue or Lincoln Road approaches and expect a substantial walk from Grand Army Plaza.
features.source_label: Prospect Park Alliance and NYC Parks

features.description: Children's Corner groups the carousel, Lefferts Historic House, and nearby family attractions near Flatbush Avenue; each attraction keeps its own schedule and fees.

features.description: Prospect Park Zoo is a separately ticketed attraction near the Flatbush Avenue side, not a free park amenity; use the zoo entrance rather than navigating to the park center.

features.name: Nethermead and Dog Beach
features.description: The Nethermead is a large central meadow reached by internal paths; Dog Beach is elsewhere near Long Meadow and has specific dog-use rules rather than all-day off-leash access.
features.source_label: Prospect Park Alliance and NYC Parks

features.description: Grand Army Plaza is Prospect Park's monumental northern entrance and a major transit arrival; use the arch and plaza to orient toward Long Meadow and park paths.
